name: Death Before Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that at creation, God declared all He made as very good, indicating the absence of death or corruption in the original order (Genesis 1:31). Death was not part of the created world but entered only after sin, as God warned that eating from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil would bring death (Genesis 2:17). This connection is affirmed in Romans 5:12, which explains that death came into the world through sin, affecting all humanity because all have sinned. Thus, death is a direct consequence of sin, not a condition that existed before it.
